purpose: Diversify KUSTO beyond NOAA/USGS/AusSeabed by discovering real EMODnet survey lineages in four European sea basins without reading bathymetric depth values.
selection_rule: Geographic basin probes frozen independently of anomaly morphology; no switching points after source outcomes.
promotion_rule: Only explicit acquisition-level survey/CDI identities can enter later cross-survey validation. Composite DTM/HR-DTM identities remain context-only.
